notes.title: SELF - April Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

I hope everything goes well.

It's been a while since our last update, we've got a very special update for you this week! In addition to some polishes and bug fixes, we've also added a mode for improving the color accessibility. I hope this can help more players can enjoy SELF easily as we do have many simple colored graphics in our game.

[h2]Full patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new color mode for improving the color accessibility
[*] Added window mode has multiple resolutions support
[*] Improved reading experience by adjusting the effects on the texts in the game carefully
[*] Added Traditional Chinese support
[*] Edited text and spelling correction
[*] Other minor fixes and polishes
[/list]

Compare figure before and after enabling the assist color mode:

[h3]BEFORE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/bcfa9addf2932b06da10fd353ad525478a359e14.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/6f62190a7b70fbe29c116f743141713d91241e01.jpg[/img]

[h3]AFTER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/de5a7123930aadf138ea4c8bae3468ac301be4cf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/a5af9e5f9ea6f3b997b193116e81e010e4b15222.png[/img]

Another good news is that SELF trading cards with which you can unlock new emoticons and profile backgrounds are now available!

:selfs::selfok::selfhappy::selfsad::selffive::selffour::selfthree::selfone:

We are preparing a patch for the Nintendo Switch version too, please be patient as it will take a bit longer as there are more restricted QA process for the console version.
